title: Glecaprevir/Pibrentasvir Drug Use Results Survey in Patients Infected With Hepatitis C Virus Genotype 1-6
brief_summary: This multi-center, post-marketing, observational study evaluates the real world safety and effectiveness of glecaprevir plus pibrentasvir use in participants infected with the hepatitis C virus genotype 1 - 6.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with chronic hepatitis C virus infection and administering glecaprevir plus pibrentasvir.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients previously treated with glecaprevir plus pibrentasvir.
study_population: Japan patients infected with hepatitis C virus and treating with glecaprevir plus pibrentasvir per approved Japan label.
